steps.text: Record the iGateway's Insteon ID, printed on its label in the XX.XX.XX format.
Plug one end of the included Ethernet cable into your internet router and the other end into the jack on the bottom of iGateway.
Plug iGateway into an unswitched outlet.
steps.expect: Status LED turns on solid blue, the Ethernet status LED turns on solid green and the Ethernet jack LED blinks yellow

steps.text: Log on to the Smarthome Connect portal, creating an account if you don't have one.
In Smarthome Connect, go to Settings, then iGateways, click Add New iGateway, enter the requested information and click Add.
steps.expect: Within about a minute the portal shows that iGateway has been successfully added

steps.text: Click the Devices tab and follow the instructions to add responders to iGateway.

notes: You can use the pass-through outlet as an ordinary uncontrolled outlet, but avoid stacking Insteon devices or other heat-generating power supplies on it.
It may be easier to add devices while they are next to iGateway and move them to their final locations afterward; they keep their settings while unplugged.

steps.text: Remove any devices linked to iGateway through Smarthome Connect.
Database reset: unplug iGateway.
Wait about 10 seconds.
While holding down the SET button, plug iGateway back in, making sure not to let go of the SET button.
steps.expect: Blue status LED turns on solid

steps.text: Continue to hold down the SET button for 3 seconds and then release it.
steps.expect: After a few seconds, the blue status LED flashes once and then turns on solid

steps.text: Registration reset: unplug iGateway.
Wait about 10 seconds.
Plug iGateway back in.
Press and hold the SET button for 3 seconds.
Tap the SET button five times quickly.
Wait 10 seconds.
Unplug iGateway.
Wait 10 seconds.
Plug iGateway back in.

notes: A full factory reset needs both procedures, starting with the database reset. The database reset erases all links; the registration reset deletes the Smarthome Connect registration ID.
Each reset can also be done on its own: a database reset when a responder can't be unlinked manually, a registration reset before re-registering an iGateway already deleted from Smarthome Connect.

steps.text: Delete the devices linked to iGateway in Smarthome Connect.
Perform a database reset.
Delete iGateway from Smarthome Connect, then perform a registration reset; deleting it from the portal does not remove the registration ID.

verification.note: Assembled from the iGateway 2423A4 Owner's Manual's reset section; the manual has no separate removal procedure.
